ingredients: 1 can pie filling (flavor of your choice)
directions: Warm milk and stir in yeast and sugar until dissolved.
Add melted margarine and beaten egg.
Add salt and flour. Mix to form a dough.
Let rise until doubled in size.
Form into balls and place on baking sheets. Let rise again.
Gently press down the center of each ball and place 1 tsp of pie filling in the indent.
Cool on a rack and drizzle with frosting.
